allocation_complete.reason: The fault report is covered by BMS_REQ_ISOLATION_FAULT, but the claimed BMS contactor opening 'within its own reaction time' is backed by BMS_REQ_FAULT_REACTION_TIME, which applies to cell-protection limit violations, not to isolation faults; no BMS requirement bounds the isolation-fault reporting latency within the 100 ms budget.
allocation_complete.suggestion: Allocate (or request from the BMS supplier) a requirement bounding the isolation-fault report/reaction latency, or drop the reaction-time claim and BMS_REQ_FAULT_REACTION_TIME; align with ARCH_VCU_HV_SHUTDOWN on who opens the contactors.

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_ISOLATION_FAULT and BMS_REQ_FAULT_REACTION_TIME are tagged interface and exist only in BEV products.

no_value_copy.reason: Neither 500 ohm/V nor 50 ms is restated.

parent_fit.reason: Detects and reports the isolation fault that triggers the vehicle HV shutdown in REQ_HV_SHUTDOWN_ON_ISOLATION_FAULT.

variant_consistency.reason: bms folder (bev), same as the bev-gated parent.
